description: Original, illustrative class-pair combinations. A rule matches when one active medicine is in group_a and a different active medicine is in group_b. NOT derived from any licensed interaction database.

rules.description: Two or more medicines that slow the nervous system.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Two medicines that cause sleepiness
rules.risk_summary: Together these kinds of medicines can add up to more sleepiness, slower breathing and a higher fall risk.

rules.description: Blood thinner together with an NSAID pain reliever.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: Blood thinner with an NSAID
rules.risk_summary: Together these kinds of medicines can raise the chance of bleeding.

rules.description: Two or more medicines with anticholinergic effects.
rules.source_note: Illustrative placeholder written for MedWatch; no external source reproduced.
rules.title: More than one anticholinergic medicine
rules.risk_summary: Together these kinds of medicines can add up to more confusion, dry mouth and constipation.
